messages:
harper: Quick update: shipping 'burst buffers' (prepaid credit pools) + invoice smoothing next week. Short summary here.

harper: Core idea: customers can pre-deposit USD into a named buffer that usage draws from first. For day-of spikes we apply a 7-day smoothing window on overage lines so invoices look less spiky.

drew: Mechanics: create buffer -> immediate charge -> buffer balance decrements per-request. If buffer is depleted, billing falls back to metered or a configured fallback. Buffers are org-scoped but attachable to routes.

billing-bot: Refunds: unused buffer balance refundable on request, processed within 30 days. Small processing fee applies for refunds below $120, waived otherwise.

cs-lead: CS prep: one-pager + FAQ incoming. Important to note: trial/free promo credits will NOT be auto-consumed by buffers unless customer toggles the setting in Billing. We'll include examples.

harper: Example CLI: 
```
redwood billing buffers create --name mobile-buffer --amount 3000 --currency USD --region us-west-2
redwood billing buffers attach --buffer-id <id> --route "/v1/generate"
```

ops-bot: Rollout: billing-service v4.0.0, canary Fri 03:00 UTC, global over 6h. Feature flag: billing.buffers.v1. Post-deploy migration will reconcile pending adjustments.

drew: API endpoints: POST /billing/buffers, GET /billing/buffers/{id}/balance, POST /billing/buffers/{id}/topup. Auth: org.billing scope.

billing-bot: Note: buffers do NOT bypass rate limits or quota enforcement. They only change billing path.

cs-lead: Support notes: watch for questions about invoice lines. We'll show buffer id & route label on invoice items. Draft answers at internal doc.

harper: Launch timeline: canary Fri -> Console flag + docs Tue -> GA next Mon. Ping me if you spot any blockers. :thumbsup:
